title: Hearty Venezuelan Plantain Curry
description: A funky and comforting Venezuelan dish featuring ginger garlic paste and plantains, cooked in a banana leaf vessel
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
Cut a slit down one side of each plantain and peel
In a blender or food processor, combine ginger garlic paste, onion, tandoor spice blend, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth
In a large bowl, combine the blended spice mixture and coconut milk, and stir until well combined
Add the plantains to the bowl and toss until they are evenly coated with the spice mixture
Spoon the plantain mixture onto the center of each banana leaf
Fold the banana leaves over the filling to form a packet, and secure with toothpicks if needed
Place the packets in a single layer on a baking sheet and bake for 30 minutes
Serve the plantains hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired
